messages:
anne_product: Quick sync — we need to lock down GA guardrails for the prompt-regression work + pricing knobs before next week. Can we land a short checklist and clear owners? :eyes:

mike_eng: +1. From engineering side: define SLOs (p95/p99 latency, availability), fallback model variants, and a "billing-safe mode" when token cost exceeds threshold. Also need a canary plan.

sam_sre: SRE input: error budgets, alert routing, and runbooks. We should add synthetic prompt-regression tests that run in prod-like canary traffic. Canary window should be at least 24h with traffic ramp.

jess_docs: Docs plan: API examples, migration notes, prompt-regression dashboard docs, and a short "what to expect" section for customers. We also need an "eval set" owner and a reproducible test harness.

lara_finops: Pricing knobs notes: define throttle tiers, per-request caps, dynamic fallback to cheaper model, and a billing backfill policy for early adopters. Need to confirm how grace periods look for pilots.

rob_support: Support ops: propose 24x7 coverage for first 72h post-GA, a degraded-throughput playbook, and a canned customer comms template. Also need escalation matrix (who paged at what time).

mike_eng: Minimal SLO sketch I put together:
```
SLO: 99.9% availability (monthly)
SLO: p95 latency < 200ms gen (small models)
SLO: p99 tail latency < 800ms (typical seqs)
Alert: > 3% error rate sustained for 5m -> page oncall
Fallback: autopromotion to cheaper model if cost threshold hit
```

anne_product: That SLO sketch looks good as a starting point. Ownership proposal: runtime & fallbacks -> @mike_eng, monitoring & alerts + canary -> @sam_sre, docs/evals -> @jess_docs, pricing/backfill -> @lara_finops, support/runbooks -> @rob_support, eval sets -> @anne_product. Anyone object? :hand:

sam_sre: No objections. Blocker: we need a synthetic dataset representing top-10 customer prompt patterns (privacy-safe). Can we get that in ~3 days?

jess_docs: I can assemble public-safe examples and the harness in 2 business days. Will sync with @anne_product on priorities.

lara_finops: Need a quick call with billing infra to confirm backfill mechanics (credit vs invoice adj). Looping in billing-bot for status.

billing-bot: billing infra note: billing API v2 (retro-credit) is on staging, deploy scheduled 2026-04-01. API docs update pending.

rob_support: I'll draft the support templates and a triage checklist today. Can share in #support tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy for prompt-regression checks scheduled: tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Will run traffic ramp script. :rocket:

anne_product: Awesome. I'll create a small Kanban in the launch board and set a final signoff sync for Friday 16:00 PT. Tentative action list (owners):
- Runtime SLOs + fallback tests -> @mike_eng
- Canary + monitoring dashboards -> @sam_sre
- Eval harness + docs -> @jess_docs
- Pricing knobs + backfill policy -> @lara_finops
- Support playbook + comms -> @rob_support
- Collect eval prompts (privacy-safe) -> @anne_product

anne_product: Please reply here if ETA changes or there are blockers. I want to minimize surprises during the GA cut. :white_check_mark:
